differences.a_observable: Background and foreground tiles are out of focus due to shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: All tiles across the frame are uniformly sharp with no depth of field blur.
differences.fix: Enable camera depth of field to match the reference blur.

differences.a_observable: Strong contact shadows are present under the tiles, creating depth.
differences.b_observable: Contact shadows are nearly absent, making the tiles look flat.
differences.fix: Add ambient occlusion or strengthen contact shadows.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Enable camera depth of field with a wider aperture to reproduce the soft background blur.

differences.a_observable: Camera has a low oblique angle, creating a strong 3D perspective.
differences.b_observable: Camera is closer to a flat top-down view, reducing perspective depth.
differences.fix: Adjust camera pitch and focal length to match the reference's oblique perspective.

differences.a_observable: Strong corner shading and vignette are visible.
differences.b_observable: Flat lighting across the frame with minimal vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette to match the corner falloff of the reference.

differences.a_observable: Yellow and blue tiles are highly saturated.
differences.b_observable: Tiles appear desaturated and washed out.
differences.fix: Increase color saturation to match the reference.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera angle and focal length to restore the oblique 3D perspective.
